llm_response.reason: The URL http://mail.support-center.fb-business.com/ is likely a scam because it mimics a legitimate Facebook business support URL, has a suspicious domain name 'fb-business.com' which is not an official Facebook domain, and returned a 403 status code. The DNS record for 'fb-business.com' showed an unusual HINFO record, further raising suspicions. These characteristics align with tactics used by scammers to gain trust and potentially trick victims into divulging sensitive information or installing malware.
